# HOST_EXPOSURE

The hostnames a cluster serves through the lab's edge, and where to dial them.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix from nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `exposure`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.exposure`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.

## Fields

| field | type |
| --- | --- |
| edge | null or record { backend, httpPort, httpsPort } |
| hosts | list of DNS name |
